🫏 New post ready 📚 List · love · 8 slides “the parts of sharing a life that cost nothing” 📝 Slides
1. the parts of sharing a life that cost nothing 2. taking your side in the hallway before hearing what the argument was even about. 3. leaving the better pillow on your side of the mattress, seven nights a week. 4. plugging your phone into the wall by the lamp, because you fell asleep on the rug. 5. three words mouthed across a crowded kitchen: let's go home. 6. walking back two blocks in the rain to get the car, so you can wait under the dry shop awning. 7. pulling the duvet back over your shoulder at four in the morning, without waking up enough to remember doing it. 8. save this for a quiet sunday evening, to remember how much of it is free.
✍️ Caption
we spend so much time worrying about the rent and the groceries. my partner still leaves the warm crust of the loaf for me at breakfast. the best parts of building a home never show up on a receipt. save this for a long week when you forget why you share a kitchen with someone. #relationshipquotes #quotesaboutlove #livingtogether #couples
